Questions

Before you join

Is this medical advice or therapy?

No. The masterclass is educational content from a brain coach. It doesn’t diagnose or treat anything and isn’t a replacement for your doctor or a licensed professional.

What if I can’t make it live?

Every seat comes with 7 days of replay access, so you can watch when it suits you.

Do I need any background in neuroscience?

Not at all. Everything is explained in plain English, with a practice you can follow along with.

Why only $17?

Because the first step should be easy. Start here, and if you want more support, there’s a way to work with Ashleigh privately afterwards.
